This bail application is filed under section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS').

2. Petitioners are accused Nos. 1 and 2 in Crime No.924/2025 of Museum Police Station,
Thiruvananthapuram District; alleging offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3.
The prosecution case is that, the first petitioner married the de facto complainant on 15.05.2022 and thereafter harassed her physically and mentally and thereby committed the offences alleged.
Petitioners are the husband and mother-in-law of the de facto complainant.
4. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioners would submit that petitioners are absolutely innocent and that they have been falsely implicated in a crime for justifying a matrimonial dispute.
5. I have heard the learned Public Prosecutor also.

6. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the nature of the allegations, I am of the opinion that petitioners can be granted anticipatory bail subject to conditions, since the dispute stems from a matrimonial relationship.
7. In the result, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the petitioners BAIL APPL. NO. 6764 OF 2025 2025:KER:38521 shall be released on anticipatory bail, in the event of their arrest in Crime No.924/2025 of Museum Police Station, Thiruvananthapuram District; subject to the following Nidal Nazeer vs State Of Kerala on 2 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59723271/
2 conditions:-
(i) Petitioners shall execute separate bonds for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum before the Investigating Officer.
(ii) Petitioners shall appear before the investigating officer in Crime No.924/2025 of Museum Police Station, Thiruvananthapuram District; as and when required.
(iii) Petitioners shall not attempt to contact the de facto complainant or interfere with the investigation or influence or intimidate any witness in Crime No.924/2025 of Museum Police Station, Thiruvananthapuram District;.
